scope: Real hosted FastAPI/PostgreSQL/Redis-compatible KV and authenticated WebSocket; GPS is synthetic

checks.name: Deployed managed-trip API and real dependencies are healthy
Trip start is protected before sign-in
Private owner sign-in returns a JWT
All pre-upgrade vehicle identities are preserved
Legacy sample vehicles are marked without deleting them
All 2,184 pre-upgrade synthetic history records are still readable
Vehicle registration creates a non-seeded PostgreSQL record
Duplicate vehicle registration is rejected
WebSocket authenticates and reports connected Redis fan-out
Explicit start creates an active synthetic trip
One active trip per vehicle is enforced
New trip samples stream over the real authenticated WebSocket
Deliberate speeding fixture produces a trip-scoped live alert
Redis GEO contains the new vehicle position
Trip detail reads its stored route and alert from PostgreSQL
All reviewed samples and alerts belong to this explicit trip
Finish durably closes the trip with a manual reason
Repeated finish is idempotent
No new GPS samples are stored after finish
Historical retry after completion does not duplicate a sample
New samples for a completed trip are rejected
A new session can reopen the saved completed trip
Automatic time limit stops and saves a separate trip
Second trip history does not borrow the first trip route or alerts
Outbox drains and hosted dependencies remain healthy

note: Backend code is unchanged in subsequent frontend asset-versioning commits. This record is restored from the retained successful verification output.
